comparison.objective: Sequence dock-line handling so engine thrust springs a boat clear, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed multi-line release, retention, and retrieval around an externally driven boat versus small-tool alignment, fine rotary control, locking, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Three lines aboard before engine action, one bow spring retained until the stern clears, then all four aboard versus two safe carriage stops and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Both interact with dynamic response, but line sequencing under thrust is not damping calibration. No spec versions are present; the body omits clearance, line-placement, and timing tolerances beyond the 30 s/10 s schedule.
